notes: The native Linux build (tools/build_linux.py, workflow/docs/linux_build.md): a 32-bit (i686) ELF with the same SDL layer as the Windows build.
The Win32 declarations come from Wine's headers (libwine-dev), used at build time only; nothing of Wine is linked. A system libwine-dev is used when present, otherwise the pinned package below.
SDL2 and SDL2_ttf: their headers come from config/sdl.json's packages; the program links against the system's 32-bit runtime libraries (libsdl2-2.0-0:i386, libsdl2-ttf-2.0-0:i386).
